answer: Re-attestations are stored in pigment and vine lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the reef graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1467 impostors cost 279 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
